status: proposed, not run. No experiment executed in this pass. All candidates are one-variable ablations from the frozen D2 setup.

baseline_reference.caveat: Single training seed. Dev seeds were used for selection only. Any improvement claim needs fresh eval seeds and at least 2 training seeds.

budget_reference.observed: 48 D2 updates took 796.987 s (about 13.3 min) with one launcher and one worker (per reference doc)
budget_reference.two_seed_paired_fit: Candidate + baseline at 2 training seeds = 4 arms, about 53 min. Does NOT fit one 30-min window. Proposal for approval, not automatic capex expansion. Baseline seed 2 does not yet exist.

keep_reject_rule_common: Survival (mean alive frames) is primary. Keep only if, at matched updates and matched fresh eval seeds, the gain exceeds seed spread across at least 2 training seeds AND Q1 does not fall. Reject if gain is within spread or Q1 falls. EV, target variance, and residual variance are diagnostics only; no EV threshold. Rewards unchanged.

candidates.name: Critic stop-gradient into shared trunk
candidates.label: Dodge adaptation of separate-critic idea
candidates.variable: Detach trunk features for the value head only. Policy trains the trunk; value head trains on detached features. Single variable. No change to lr, epochs, or loss weights.
candidates.literature: PPG (2009.04416, abstract: separate networks avoid interference; shared allows features to be shared). Andrychowicz 2020 Sec. 3.2 (separate networks better in 4/5 envs). Neither tests this exact one-way stop-gradient. Abstract/summary level only.

hypotheses.H1_interference: Critic gradients hurt policy trunk. Predicts survival gain.
hypotheses.H2_lost_value_shaping: Trunk loses value information. Predicts EV worse, survival unchanged or worse.
hypotheses.H3_capacity: Critic head limited to frozen features. Predicts EV change, survival unchanged.

candidates.cheapest_discriminating_measurement: Same 48-update harness. Log per-update: actor and critic gradient norms SEPARATELY on the trunk (not the mixed trunk norm), target variance, residual variance, EV, survival. Compare late-window (9-16 vs 41-48) slopes. Survival decides; the gradient split discriminates H1 from H2/H3.
candidates.cost: About 13.3 min per arm, 1 seed. Fits local cap for one arm.
risks: Trunk learns from policy only, may slow critic fit
failure_cases: Survival unchanged or worse with EV worse (H2/H3)
EV rises while survival falls (H3-like or noise)
candidates.criterion_keep: Survival gain beyond spread across 2 seeds, Q1 not falling.
candidates.criterion_reject: Gain within spread, or Q1 falls.

candidates.name: Running target-std normalization of critic targets
candidates.label: Dodge adaptation of published method (PopArt idea)
candidates.variable: Normalize GAE return targets by running mean/std before the value loss. No output-preserving weight rescaling. Reward scale 0.1 fixed. Single variable: normalization on vs off.
candidates.literature: Van Hasselt 2016 (1602.07714): adaptive target normalization, abstract. Hessel 2018 (1809.04474): PopArt name and multi-task Atari, abstract. Both value-based; no PPO test read. Engstrom 2020 Fig. 1 caption: reward normalization significant (summary level).
candidates.cheapest_discriminating_measurement: Log target variance and critic gradient norm per update. Target-variance drift is the first expected signal. Survival decides.
candidates.cost: About 13.3 min per arm, 1 seed. Low implementation cost.
risks: Changes critic loss scale relative to policy under shared trunk (vf_coef 0.5)
Global grad clip 0.5 may bind more often
Target variance drift in baseline is small (0.067 to 0.063), so the gain ceiling is low
failure_cases: Target variance unchanged (normalization not the bottleneck)
Survival worse because policy step shrinks under joint grad clip
candidates.criterion_keep: Survival gain beyond spread across 2 seeds AND target-variance drift reduced AND Q1 not falling.
candidates.criterion_reject: Survival within spread, or Q1 falls.

candidates.name: GAE lambda change (0.90 or 0.99), gamma fixed at 0.995
candidates.label: Published method family (GAE lambda tuning), speculative as survival lever
candidates.variable: gae_lambda 0.95 -> 0.90 (window 0.64 s) or 0.99 (window 4.5 s). Single variable.
candidates.literature: Schulman 2015 GAE (1506.02438): bias-variance trade-off, abstract only. No source here ties lambda to rare lethal events.
candidates.cheapest_discriminating_measurement: Log advantage variance and value-target error by lag to a death event. Survival decides.
risks: Lambda 0.90 is myopic for death 1-3 s away (weights 0.43 and 0.08 at lag 15 and 45 with 0.95)
failure_cases: Survival falls with lambda 0.90 (credit too short)
candidates.criterion_keep: Survival gain beyond spread across 2 seeds, Q1 not falling.

candidates.name: PPG-style infrequent auxiliary value phase
candidates.label: Published method (PPG), Dodge adaptation
candidates.variable: Replace per-update critic fit with periodic auxiliary phases (N_pi, E_aux). Single variable: schedule.
candidates.literature: PPG (2009.04416), abstract: phased value optimization and feature distillation. Earlier Sec. 3.3-3.4 numbers (N_pi=32, E_aux=6) not re-verified.
candidates.cheapest_discriminating_measurement: Count gradient steps and KL per rollout; compare EV and survival per update and per wall-clock.
candidates.cost: More gradient steps per rollout. Likely exceeds the 30-min local cap for 48 updates. Estimate not measured.
risks: KL early stop (target_kl 0.03, 4 epochs) interacts with phased updates
candidates.criterion_keep: Survival gain beyond spread at matched wall-clock and update count.
candidates.criterion_reject: Within spread, or wall-clock cost not justified.
candidates.depends_on: Rank 1 result (if stop-gradient shows H1, phasing is the next test)

candidates.name: Plasticity intervention in the critic
candidates.label: Published methods, speculative for PPO
candidates.variable: Feature regularization or unit reset in critic only.
candidates.literature: Dohare 2023 (supervised, abstract only), Lyle 2022 (off-policy, abstract only), Nikishin 2022 (search snippet only). Earlier notes; not re-verified.
candidates.cheapest_discriminating_measurement: Dormant or low-rank critic units over at least 100 updates. Measurement-only first.
candidates.cost: Needs 100-320 updates. Exceeds 48-update window and likely the local cap.
risks: Long-run duration confound with earlier 2240-mean checkpoint
candidates.criterion_keep: Survival gain on a longer run on fresh seeds.
candidates.criterion_reject: No dormant-unit change or no survival gain.

deprioritized.name: Value-function clipping on (vs current off)
deprioritized.reason: Current critic is unclipped (verified, ppo.py). Andrychowicz Sec. 3.4 says clipping hurts regardless of threshold. Engstrom did not name value clipping as significant. Predicted harm or no change; use only as a negative control if budget remains.

not_ranked_gaps: Memory architecture (GRU or frame stack in the policy): distinct from observation allowlist changes. POPGym GRU result unverified this pass. No Dodge-state reason to expect a gain, since the observation is visible.
Gamma change (per decision): changes value target scale and far-future weighting. No source read on Dodge-like horizon.
Exploration and curriculum for rare lethal events: no source read this pass.

horizon_reference.decision: K=4 raw frames at 60 Hz = 66.67 ms
horizon_reference.rollout_256: 256 decisions = 1024 frames = 17.1 s (256 from user request; default not confirmed in code)
